priority_country_findings.IE: Garda publishes 1901 mobile enforcement zones, not 1901 installed fixed cameras; do not inflate camera count with patrol zones. Primary parent discovery completed.
priority_country_findings.DK: Official cabinet locations and planned expansion found; future deployments are not counted as active camera GPS. Primary parent discovery completed.
priority_country_findings.IS: Additional OSM enforcement relations and precise role nodes acquired and current primary membership checked; stale unconfirmed additions were discarded, not published.
priority_country_findings.SK: Proposed camera rollout is not evidence of installed active cameras; broad bbox output clipped to country polygon.
priority_country_findings.BG: BG-Toll publishes section-control maps and traffic/weather data, but an explicit reusable camera-section coordinate license was not confirmed. Primary OSM membership discovery completed.
priority_country_findings.AL: Broad OSM speed/tag/relation passes and current membership search completed; neighboring-country nodes discarded.
priority_country_findings.ME: Broad OSM passes and current membership search completed; CCTV/patrol locations not promoted to fixed cameras.
priority_country_findings.LU: PCH licensed CC0 device points acquired; ambiguous device modes remain LOW. Current parent enforcement discovery completed.
priority_country_findings.LV: Current parent membership revealed additional explicitly ordered average-speed sections; imported after deduplication and primary API verification.
priority_country_findings.EE: Official agency cabinet totals and Tark Tee GIS reviewed; no guessed additional pins or unverified GIS license. Primary membership discovery completed.
priority_country_findings.MD: Additional OSM predicates and current membership search completed; surveillance maps not assumed to be licensed speed-camera feeds.
priority_country_findings.CY: Official CC-BY DATEX installed-equipment feed acquired; missing individual enforcement mode remains LOW, separate from published OSM observations.
priority_country_findings.MT: Additional speed/enforcement queries and current membership search completed; statistical counts are not camera GPS.

zero_growth_interpretation: No additional eligible unique source objects found in the completed acquisitions; not proof that no undiscovered cameras exist.
freshness_policy: Overpass snapshot timestamps are preserved, not assumed current. Newly publishable OSM IDs and explicit relation/device/endpoints are re-fetched through the current primary OSM API. Original 50141 records are never refreshed or changed during this expansion.
